decisions.reason: As a certified plate heat exchanger line close to the core portfolio, it likely meets at least modest aspiration levels and, in a growing firm with R&D and portfolio slack, would normally be retained absent clear signs of underperformance.
Its earlier signal of major market share in marine water cooling places it well above aspiration, so behavioral-theory logic implies very little pressure to redeploy resources away from it.

The compact oil cooler fits existing engineering and customer channels, and with no evidence of a clear aspiration shortfall the firm would likely continue it while exploiting complementarities with the established business.

Finned tubes are somewhat more peripheral and face more performance uncertainty than the other lines, but the firm's broad offer, technical capabilities, and available slack still make continued retention more likely than withdrawal.
